peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: SKHY 26.7% with 3/3 replicate support; SMSN 20.7% with 3/3 replicate support; MU 18.7% with 3/3 replicate support; SNDK 8.3% with 3/3 replicate support; CXMT 6.7% with 3/3 replicate support; DRAM 13.3% with 2/3 replicate support; NVDA 5.7% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: SK hynix ADR
peers.reason: This is the same issuer exposure as the target in ADR form, so it should track SK hynix common more closely than any other eligible symbol; the weight is still capped because it is a wrapper rather than the excluded common line.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: Samsung Electronics common is the closest large directly traded competitor in DRAM and NAND and shares the Korean memory cycle, customer set, and supply discipline that drive SK hynix earnings.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Micron Technology is the closest pure-play listed competitor, selling DRAM, HBM, and NAND into the same AI and data-center demand cycle with the same input cost and capital expenditure dynamics, and it offers deep 24-hour perp liquidity of 59.489 USD millions.

peers.name: Sandisk
peers.reason: Sandisk is a direct NAND flash memory peer, sharing the storage segment of the memory cycle with SK hynix, and it is the most liquid name in the basket with 24-hour perp liquidity of 250.017 USD millions.

peers.name: CXMT Corp. Class A
peers.reason: CXMT is a direct DRAM supply-side competitor, making it relevant to capacity additions and pricing pressure even though its end-market mix differs from SK hynix.

peers.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
peers.reason: The Roundhill Memory ETF is a sector basket built around DRAM and NAND memory makers, so it captures the memory pricing cycle that drives the majority of SK hynix earnings and return variance; a large weight is justified because it represents the target's core industry exposure directly.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVIDIA is the dominant customer for SK hynix's high-bandwidth memory, so its AI accelerator demand directly drives SK hynix's HBM revenue expectations and the two stocks co-move on AI infrastructure news.

primary_index_hedge.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF
primary_index_hedge.reason: SK hynix is one of the largest constituents of the MSCI South Korea index, so the iShares MSCI South Korea ETF is the cleanest single hedge for the dominant Korean equity market and currency systematic risk embedded in SKHX. It is classified as an equity_etf, trades with 24-hour perp liquidity of 17.433 USD millions, and leaves the stock-specific memory cycle to be explained by the peer basket rather than by the hedge.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
